Who was elected as independent India's first President?

(I) John Mathai – Railways and Transport
(II) Jagjivan Ram – Labour
(III) Amrit Kaur – Commerce
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
faqs.e: Amrit Kaur held the Health portfolio; Commerce was held by C.H. Bhabha.

faqs.q: Which minister in the first Council of Ministers belonged to the Hindu Mahasabha and was the first to resign from the cabinet, in April 1950?
faqs.e: He held the Industries and Supplies portfolio.

(III) R.K. Shanmukham Chetty was the Minister of Finance.
Which of the above is/are correct?

Consider the following statements about the immediate challenges before independent India:
(I) Rehabilitation of nearly 60 lakh refugees who migrated from Pakistan.
(II) Abolition of the feudal set-up in agriculture.
(III) Territorial and administrative integration of princely states.
Which of the above is/are correct?
faqs.e: Abolition of the feudal agricultural set-up was classified as a medium-term challenge, not an immediate one.

faqs.q: Framing of the Constitution for India was classified under which category of challenge before the newborn nation?
National integration and poverty alleviation were classified under which category of challenge for independent India?
The Indian Independence Act laid down the procedure for resolving how many major problems arising from partition?
Which of the following was NOT one of the three major problems addressed under the Indian Independence Act's partition procedure?

options.a: Division of apparatus and personnel of the Indian Civil Services
options.c: Settlement of boundaries between the two nations
options.d: Division of military assets and formations

faqs.e: Division of cash balances was handled later by the Partition Council, not under the Act's three original problems.

faqs.q: Who chaired the Boundary Commission appointed to demarcate the India-Pakistan boundary?
Within how many weeks was the Boundary Commission required to draw the boundaries and decide disputed points?

Consider the following statements about the Boundary Commission:
(I) It consisted of two Muslim and two non-Muslim judges in each case.
(II) The 1941 census formed the basis of its decisions.
(III) Its report was made public before August 15, 1947.
Which of the above is/are correct?
faqs.e: The report was ready by August 12 but was deliberately made public only after August 15, 1947.

faqs.q: Which community, treated as a third party besides Hindus and Muslims, demanded that all its holy shrines be included in East Punjab?
The Boundary Commission's report, though ready by August 12, 1947, was intentionally released by Lord Mountbatten after which date?
Which region received the largest territorial area under the Radcliffe Boundary Award?
faqs.e: West Punjab received 62,000 square miles, the largest area among the four regions.

faqs.q: The number of Muslims left as a minority population in India was initially estimated at 42 million but was later revised down to what figure?
According to an estimate, approximately how many people were killed in the communal riots following partition, across both sides of the border?

Consider the following statements:
(I) Around 60,000 people were killed on the western side and 120,000 on the eastern side of the border.
(II) Bengal experienced comparatively less violence than Punjab, largely due to Gandhi's efforts.
(III) The Garhmukteswar violence took place in Bihar.
Which of the above is/are correct?
faqs.e: Garhmukteswar was located in the United Provinces, not Bihar.

faqs.q: In which month and year did communal riots first begin, even before the formal announcement of partition?
How many men did the governor-general assemble to form the Boundary Force to control anticipated rioting?

Who presided over the Partition Council set up to resolve the division of civil government?

Consider the following statements regarding the Partition Council:
(I) It consisted of two representatives each from India and Pakistan.
(II) It was assisted by a steering committee at the operational level.
(III) H.M. Patel and Mohammad Ali were part of this steering committee.
Which of the above is/are correct?
What share of the total cash balances did Pakistan seek during the division of finances?
Approximately how much was the amount of the 'sterling balance' owed to Pakistan that the Indian government had withheld?
faqs.e: This debt had arisen on account of Indian contributions to the Second World War.

faqs.q: Gandhi undertook a fast conditional on the transfer of withheld funds owed to which country?
Who headed the Joint Defence Council set up as Supreme Commander for dividing the armed forces after partition?

Consider the following statements about the division of defence personnel and equipment:
(I) Muslim-majority units were to be transferred to Pakistan and non-Muslim units to India.
(II) The post of Supreme Commander was abolished due to differences between the two parties.
(III) British troops completed their withdrawal from India by February 1948.
Which of the above is/are correct?

Who assassinated Mahatma Gandhi on January 30, 1948?
At which location was Mahatma Gandhi shot dead?
On which date was Mahatma Gandhi assassinated?
On which date was the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) banned by the government following Gandhi's assassination?
In which month and year was the ban on the RSS lifted?
faqs.e: The ban was lifted after the RSS agreed to restrict itself to cultural activities, renounce violence and secrecy, profess loyalty to the Constitution and flag, and organise on democratic principles.

faqs.q: Which statement did Nehru make in his radio address after Gandhi's assassination, reflecting the national mood?

options.b: "Long years ago we made a tryst with destiny"
options.d: "The light has gone out of our lives"

faqs.a: "The light has gone out of our lives"

faqs.e: Despite this influx, the Indian government did not recognise these migrants as refugees, and Nehru attempted to send them back.

faqs.e: He believed the refugee problem could only be solved through population transfer and territorial acquisition from Pakistan.

In September 1947, which thesis did Russia announce as an answer to the Marshall Plan, encouraging greater activism among international communist parties?

Consider the following statements on why Indian communists were sceptical about independence:
(I) They believed class struggle and armed insurgency were necessary to shift mass attention away from communal hatred.
(II) They were encouraged by communist successes in countries like China, Malaya, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Burma.
(III) They believed the Congress government represented genuine national liberation.
Which of the above is/are correct?
faqs.e: The communists in fact denounced the Congress government as a stooge of Anglo-American imperialism and feudal forces, not as representing genuine liberation.
